name: nvda_range_vs_aapl_range
formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low), NVDA_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close))
hypothesis: Relative intraday turbulence in NVDA versus AAPL captures sector stress that AAPL has yet to absorb.

name: msft_nvda_close_position_diff
formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_Close, NVDA_Low), subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low)), safe_divide(subtract(MSFT_Close, MSFT_Low), subtract(MSFT_High, MSFT_Low)))
hypothesis: Divergence in where peers close within their ranges shows tech-sector intraday sentiment that may lead AAPL.
